newsitem.title: INDIA: At least 35 feared drowned as India boat capsizes.
newsitem.headline: At least 35 feared drowned as India boat capsizes.

text.p: At least 35 people were feared drowned on Friday when a crowded boat capsized on a river swollen by monsoon rains in the eastern Indian state of Bihar, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
The news agency quoted officials as saying the boat on the turbulent Kosi River was carrying at least 42 passengers.
PTI said seven people managed to swim ashore.
United News of India said the boat was carrying at least 40 passengers, of whom eight were safe. The news agencies gave no other details.
Local officials said they could not confirm the toll.
They said the boat overturned near the town of Madhepura, some 320 km (190 miles) east of the state capital, Patna. Rescue efforts were hampered by the swift current, they said.
